choices.reason: The paper reports no preregistration and names neither human-rated constructiveness preference nor SMOG readability as primary or main. They are different outcomes for the same full-sample HAI-versus-human contrast, so rules 2 and 3 cannot choose between them and rules 4 through 7 do not separate them.
